messages:
Rae: Quick loop  we finished the interview with OrionForge. To ship the case study we need: signed release, a short pull quote for the product page, two tweet-length blurbs, and to confirm if they'd join a 20-min webinar demo. Raw audio + notes: https://drive.google.com/orionforge-interview :rocket:

Omar: They mentioned ~3x cost reduction and "noticeably lower tail latency" after migrating. They explicitly asked that we do not mention the previous vendor.

Lena (CS): Tech pull I recommend: 'continuous batching + KV cache reduced tail latency and per-request compute.' I can craft a 1-line version for the blog.

Noor (Legal): Uploading release template now. If we use approximate phrasing ("~3x" or "about 3x") that's fine. If they want to call out a named competitor we need supporting docs and explicit attestation. Redline: https://drive.google.com/open?id=orionforge-release-redline

Rae: Omar  please paste two quote options (cost-first and velocity-first) into the doc and send release for signature. Also ask if the CEO can join the webinar for a short Q&A.

Omar: Pasted: 
> "OrionForge reduced inference costs by ~3x while improving tail latency."
> "With Redwood we shipped a new conversational workflow in under one sprint."

CRMBot: Transcript processed and stored: /files/4132105678-orionforge-transcript.txt

Omar: Sent release + quotes to their marketing lead. Quick reply: "We'll sign but prefer 'about 3x' and can join a short webinar. No vendor names." Attached signed release: https://drive.google.com/file/d/orionforge-signed-release.pdf

Noor (Legal): Reviewed signed release, countersigned. Approved quote: "OrionForge reduced inference costs by about 3x while improving tail latency." Cleared for blog, social, and webinar promo.

Lena (CS): Final tech pull I suggest for the blog: "KV cache + optimized batching reduced our p99 by ~40% while cutting compute costs." Want me to trim to one sentence for the pull quote?

Rae: Yes please  make it one tight sentence for the homepage card. Also create two tweet-length lines. We'll schedule publish Wed AM.

Lena (CS): Uploaded assets: /marketing/assets/orionforge-quote-card.png and pushed two social lines to the doc: 
- "OrionForge cut inference spend ~3x with Redwood  faster tail latency, simpler ops."
- "Launched a new chat workflow in days after moving to Redwood."

CRMBot: HubSpot tag created: case-study/orionforge. Routing rule: owner=Midmarket SDRs. Signed release and transcript will attach to new contacts with the tag.

Rae: Great. Noor  note any edits to the quote text require re-approval. Omar  schedule internal Sales preview for Tue 10am. I'll stage assets and post live once RSVP + assets are in place.

Omar: Scheduled Sales preview and added the webinar RSVP page draft.

Noor (Legal): Confirmed. Keep the quote verbatim as in the signed release. Any deviation needs a fresh sign-off.

Rae: Thanks team  final checklist: signed release in Drive, transcript + audio trimmed, quote graphic in assets, social lines in doc, HubSpot routing set. Closing when live. :tada:
